A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, Weak-to-Strong Generalization Through the Data-Centric Lens. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–F are available and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original language-model, weak-supervision, and synthetic experiments in Section 5 and Appendix F, including overlap-density, data-selection, ablation, and robustness results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 5 and Appendix F, including slightly revised plotted results for the hard-only-density ablation.

M1.justification: Overlap detection and UCB-based data selection retain the same steps in Algorithms 1, 2, and A1. v2 removes the unused weak-to-strong model from Algorithm 2's input list without changing its operations or the representation-based implementation described in Appendix C.

E1.justification: Both versions report the same 19 language-model datasets, nine weak-supervision datasets, and synthetic Gaussian-mixture scenarios. Appendix F retains the same noise, architecture, and transfer settings.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same comparators: weak and strong reference models, Full W2S and Controlled W2S, and random sampling versus UCB, with an oracle also included in synthetic source selection.

E3.justification: The reported model configurations, linear probing, data splits, sample counts, and selection budgets remain unchanged. Appendix F.3 describes the same hard-only-density ablation procedure; its revised plot does not establish a protocol change.

E4.justification: Figure A7(b) revises the plotted evidence for whether increasing hard-only training points produces weak-to-strong generalization. The analysis question and conclusion remain unchanged, as do the other easy-only, detection-noise, architecture, and transferability analyses.

E5.justification: Figure 3 retains its average over 20 experiments with different seeds, and Tables A2–A3 retain means and standard deviations over 20 runs. Figure A7(b)'s changed shaded ranges do not introduce a different uncertainty-reporting practice or disclose additional runs.

E6.justification: Figure A7(b) slightly changes the weak-model, strong-model, and W2S accuracy curves and shaded ranges under the same reported hard-only-density setting. Their ranking and qualitative conclusion remain intact. The other result plots and Tables A2–A3 are unchanged.

T1.justification: The definitions, assumptions, Theorems 4.1–4.3, and Appendix D proofs retain their mathematical content. Changes such as Px to P and the overlap-count symbol from V-bar to O-bar are notation corrections, not revised bounds or reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: overlap density as a mechanism, overlap detection, UCB-based source selection, theoretical guarantees, and empirical validation. No central claim is broadened or narrowed.

C2.justification: The overlap-regime interpretations, explanations of ablation and noise results, and limitation to a simplified mechanism are retained. Section 3.1 corrects fweak to fw2s in one sentence, aligning it with the mechanism already explained elsewhere.

D1.justification: Section 5 newly provides an access link for the authors' implementation. Existing implementation choices, dataset statistics, and hardware information in Appendices C and E remain unchanged; the PDFs alone do not verify the repository's contents.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B, and the cited works remain unchanged. The references shift following the added acknowledgments, without changing research positioning or citation membership.

P1.justification: v2 adds the ICLR 2025 publication header and acknowledgments, expands several captions, and makes local wording and notation corrections. The main narrative and appendix organization are retained.

P2.justification: Captions for Figures A2, A14, and A15 now explain the existing curves. Figure A7(b) corrects its horizontal-axis label from Easy Ratio to Hard Ratio and revises the plotted panel. Headers and limited text reflow change layout; no figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: The implementation link, clearer appendix captions, corrected Figure A7(b) axis, and local notation fixes modestly improve access information and readability. The small numerical revision in A7(b) is unexplained but preserves its conclusion. The scientific scope and supporting theory and experiments otherwise remain essentially unchanged.
